started: The audit started; its progress shows here and in the sidebar.
manualOnly: Audited only when you start it
meterText: The crawl runs on the server: the first {free} addresses each month are free, then {credits} credits per 1,000 addresses.
localText: The crawl runs on this computer and is free.
waiting: Queued: it starts when one of the server's crawls ends
finalizing: Running the checks and saving the results…
geoHint: How ready the site is to be read, quoted and cited in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews)
geoHint_ai_search_access: Crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Claude-SearchBot must not be blocked in robots.txt, or the site does not appear in AI search.
geoHint_ai_assistant_access: ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and the like read a page when a user asks for it.
geoHint_llms_txt: An /llms.txt file summarising the site's key pages for language models.
geoHint_snippets_allowed: nosnippet, or a max-snippet under 50 characters, keeps a page from being quoted in AI answers.
geoHint_structured_data: Share of indexable pages with valid JSON-LD.
geoHint_entity_schema: Organization and WebSite schema tell models plainly who the site belongs to.
geoHint_question_headings: Share of pages with enough content that have an H2/H3 phrased as a question; a question-and-answer layout is easier to quote.
geoHint_substantial_content: Share of indexable pages with at least 300 words.
robotsUnreachable: robots.txt could not be read; crawlers treat the whole site as blocked.
robotsMissing: No robots.txt; every crawler can enter.
issuesHint: 118 checks; open one to see why it matters, how to fix it and where it was found
runningText: Crawling {domain}. The results show here when it ends.
stopped: The audit was stopped early; the results cover the pages crawled.
interrupted: The audit was interrupted because the program closed.
metered: {pages} addresses of this audit were charged to your credits ({share}).
emptyText: An audit crawls {domain}, runs 118 technical checks and measures how ready the site is for AI answers. Start one above.
deleteConfirm: Delete this audit and its crawl?
checkOutboundHint: Links to other sites are opened once to find broken ones; each counts as a page.
findingsCsvHint: Every check with every address it was found on, in one file
noCrawl: This audit has no crawl to read.
trendHint: Technical health, GEO readiness and findings
trendOne: The chart needs at least two finished audits.
orphansHint: In the sitemap, linked from no page
noSitemaps: The crawl read no sitemap, so orphan pages cannot be found.
weakHint: Indexable pages linked from one page or none
depthHint: Important pages should be at most 3 clicks from the home page.
weakText: Link to these pages from related pages and menus; search engines find them more easily and treat them as more important.
topTitle: Pages with the most internal PageRank
topText: The pages the site's own links strengthen most; your key pages should be here.
rankHelp: PageRank computed from the site's followed internal links, on a 0–100 logarithmic scale: the strongest page is 100.
noHreflangText: No hreflang annotations on the crawled pages. A single-language site does not need them.
hreflangPagesHint: Pages pointing to other language versions
pagesExplorerHint: Every crawled page: search, filter and sort; open one for its findings and links.
vitalsHint: What real Chrome users experience (CrUX) and PageSpeed runs of your key pages
vitalsNeedKey: Enter your Google API key on the Sources page (with the PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report APIs enabled). It is free.
vitalsPagesHint: One address a line, up to {n}
vitalsFree: Free within Google's daily quota; each page takes 10–30 seconds.
vitalsEmptyText: A check brings your site's real-user data and your pages' speed scores.
vitalsAssessmentHint: Passes when LCP, INP and CLS are all good
noOriginData: Chrome has too few visits to this site to report; only lab runs are shown.
vitalsPagesTableHint: Open a page for the fixes that would save the most time.
